topic: Study of pressure distribution over an aerofoil at various angles of attack, determination of center of pressure and aerodynamic center.
syllabus_extract: Study of pressure distribution over an aerofoil at various angles of attack, determination of center of pressure and aerodynamic center.
specific_objectives: 10.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the properties of atmosphere, flow over bodies, boundary layer and various concepts of Aerodynamics.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Analysis of pressure distribution data plots to locate CP and AC; Safety: No physical handling of live instruments; Instructor supervision: Monitor data interpretation accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the definition of angle of attack?
How does pressure vary over a symmetrical aerofoil?
Define the boundary layer in the context of flow over a body.

topics: Pressure distribution curves at low angles
Effect of increasing angle of attack

Identification of stagnation points

topics: Definition and movement of Center of Pressure

development.content:
Definition and movement of Center of Pressure

summary_questions: Explain why the center of pressure moves as the angle of attack changes.
Why is the aerodynamic center preferred over the center of pressure for stability analysis?
Describe the relationship between pressure distribution and the resultant lift vector.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of Center of Pressure and Aerodynamic Center apply to the longitudinal stability requirements discussed in LP 11.
